# Misuc DAW — Component Status Report (auto-generated)
#
# This file is the single source of truth for component status.
# Every section maps 1:1 to a COMPONENT_STATUS_MATRIX entry.
#
# Update this file whenever a component's status changes.

## A. Audio foundation (master limiter, headroom, meters)

| Component | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Master limiter | REAL | Brickwall feed-forward limiter at −1 dBFS, ON by default. Live == export. |
| Headroom policy | PARTIAL | Default ceiling −1 dBFS; `setCeiling` exists on the DSP struct but is NOT wired to any UI/control — ceiling is effectively fixed until the headroom control is implemented. |
| True-peak meter | PARTIAL | Catmull-Rom *midpoint* estimate (one u=0.5 per sample pair — not 4x oversampling) applied to **master meters only**; per-track/bus use plain peak/RMS. Phase note: status file previously overstated this as "4x oversampled per-track/bus/master". |
| Clip indicator | REAL | Per-track/bus/master; sticky until reset. |
| xrun/glitch | REAL | Graceful fallback; underrun logged, no crash. |

## B. Project & persistence (`.misuc` v3)

| Component | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `.misuc` v3 schema | REAL | `"format":"misuc.song"`, `schemaVersion`, timestamps, additive v3+ members. |
| Native container | REAL | **Comp17 (#14):** every `.misuc` document is a REAL ZIP container (`misuc.meta` carrying `"format":"misuc.container"` + `containerVersion` + modifiedUtc, and `misuc.song` holding the session JSON), zlib-deflate + CRC32-verified, parsed via EOCD + central directory with bounds checks; truncated / bit-flipped / missing files rejected. Legacy plain-JSON `.misuc` files (previous builds) load transparently and are migrated back to the container format on the next save. Save / Open / autosave-rotate+verify / recovery / demo project all go through `writeProjectDocument`/`readProjectDocument`. |
| Atomic write | REAL | Temp file + rename; crash-safe. |
| Autosave | REAL | Comp09: configurable interval (Off / 1/5/10/15/30/60 min) persisted via QSettings (`autosave/intervalSeconds`, default 90 s; 0 = disabled) and applied live to the timer; recovery group in the existing Settings UI (Autosave toggle + Interval combo + "Save Recovery Copy Now" + location note); rotates current->.prev with validate-before-promote, atomic write, re-verifies round-trip, superseded+cleaned on normal save; recovery prompt on next launch. |

## O. Per-block fx control smoothing (Phase O)

| Component | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Engine sub-block smoothing | REAL (DONE Sep 2026) | Inside each 8192-frame render segment, fx inserts are now processed in 64-frame control blocks (`kFxControlFrames = 64`): the automation curve is sampled at the exact beat of each sub-block start and applied to each insert immediately before its `process()`/`run()` call. This replaces the old one-sample-per-segment hold so a curve step or ramp that lands mid-segment takes effect at the next 64-frame boundary instead of waiting until the next segment. At 48 kHz this gives ~750 Hz control rate (1.33 ms latency vs the old ~170 ms segment hold). Live and offline (`renderToWav`) share the identical sub-block path, so export == monitor. |
| Build-in EQ anti-zipper | REAL (DONE Sep 2026) | `ParametricEq::setPort` recomputes biquad coefficients at each 64-frame boundary when an automation curve is active, producing smooth coefficient tracking instead of a single per-segment step. The filter's response glides continuously (sample-accurate piecewise-linear input at the control rate); the built-in EQ and all hostable LV2 plugins behave identically under sub-blocking (stateless biquad chain / mda-class DSP). |
| Tests | REAL (DONE Sep 2026) | `fx_automation_midsegment_step_is_audible`: LP step at beat 0.2 inside the first 8192-frame segment proves the per-block cadence — the 5000..8191 window is already dark (the old segment hold kept it bright). `fx_automation_ramp_tracks_progressively`: fast LP ramp 20 kHz→100 Hz over beat 0..1 measures early-seg brightness vs late-seg darkness, pinning smooth tracking across segments. 55228/0 + 443/0 green. |

## P. Export === live fx cadence (Phase P)

| Component | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Mid-segment step audible in export | REAL (DONE Sep 2026) | `fx_automation_midsegment_step_is_audible_in_export`: the LP-curve step at beat 0.2 is heard in the RENDERED wav too (L frames 5000..8191 of the export), proving the offline renderer runs the same every-64-frame sub-block path as the live engine. |
| Export == live, bit-exact | REAL (DONE Sep 2026) | `fx_automation_export_matches_live_cadence`: one Session, monolithic live `process()` vs `renderToFile` 512-chunk loop — `memcmp`-identical. ## FLP import completion (Comp10, #7 Parts 3–16)

| Component | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Structural decoder | REAL | Clean-room structural FLP reader (channels/patterns/playlist/mixer/tempo); **zlib-compressed ("zipped") FLdt payloads now inflate** via `inflateZlib` + `rebuildContainer` and decode identically to uncompressed files (F4/F5 legacy wrappers still rejected with a clear error). |
| Channel-rack materialization | REAL | Every FL channel becomes a track AND a persisted channel-rack row. Sampler channels (FL type 0) become Sampler rows carrying the resolved sample in `soundFile`; pitched generators become Instrument rows (notes play via the generic synth voice). |
| Unsupported plugin placeholders | REAL | Channels backed by a specific FL plugin (non-empty InternalName) keep their preserved name as an Instrument row and are listed in the import report (`unsupportedPlugins` / `unsupportedPluginNames`); FL plugin binaries are never hosted. |
| Sample path resolution | REAL | Relative sample paths resolve against the .flp's directory (`importSession(flp, baseDir)`); absolute paths pass through. `samplesFound`/`samplesMissing` count disk truth; missing paths are kept on the row (re-pointable) and reported. |
| Pattern → timeline | REAL | The busiest arrangement becomes the timeline; one MIDI region per (item, channel) with real per-note timing (24-byte and legacy 8-byte note structs); length from item → pattern Length → last note. Tempo imported; time signature stays 4/4 (documented limitation). |
| Sampler-note honesty | PARTIAL (documented) | Sampler-channel note hits are still not rendered (Misuc regions are pitched); rows are preserved and auditionable, hits counted + warned. This is stated honestly in the import dialog, not hidden. |
| Import report | REAL | `FlpImportResult` carries counts (channels/sampler/patterns/notes/regions/clips/sampler hits/samples found+missing, with missing paths + unsupported plugin names); MainWindow's import dialog shows a compact summary. |
| Real playback | REAL | Imported projects render through the normal transport: QA imports a representative FLP (FL Keys generator w/ 4-beat melody + sampler + missing sample + arrangement), plays it headless and asserts master peak > 0.01. |
| Import lifecycle | REAL | `MainWindow::importFlpFromPath` (public, dialog-free for QA/tests) adopts the project: `dirty_=true`, cleared project path (must Save As), fresh undo; save adds the Recent entry, import does not; .misuc reopen + playback verified. |

## Windows port (branch: windows-port, Oct 2026)

| Component | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| WASAPI backend | REAL (code-complete) | Native shared-mode WASAPI backend satisfying the same `AudioBackend` contract as PipeWire: endpoint enumeration (friendly names, default endpoint first), event-driven render loop with per-callback frame negotiation, IEEE-float request at the configured rate/channels with WASAPI-side conversion (`AUTOCONVERTPCM`, Win10 1703+, mix-format fallback for older hosts), capture thread writing the same "latest snapshot" input scratch, MMCSS "Pro Audio" on both threads, QPC-gap xrun counter (same >3x heuristic), padding-derived output latency. Backend chosen per platform in CMake (`MISUC_BACKEND_WASAPI` / `MISUC_BACKEND_PIPEWIRE`); AudioEngine + misuc_app pick the platform default. |
| Not yet validated on real hardware | NOT CLAIMED | Device behaviour (latency figures, xrun soak, capture) has not been exercised on Windows hardware yet. CI proof as of Oct 2026: the `windows` workflow is fully green (commit e739d7b) — MSVC 2022 build, all ctest suites pass, windeployqt + portable ZIP artifact `misuc-windows` (~29 MB) upload. The live WASAPI suite (`wasapi_device_enumeration`, `wasapi_stream_lifecycle`) skips on the deviceless runner, and the runner's phantom default endpoint aborts a live render cycle, so audio-device validation remains unproven. |
| Build wiring | REAL | PipeWire/ALSA/pkg-config are required only off-Windows; Windows uses vcpkg manifest (`vcpkg.json`: zlib+libsndfile; upstream's `SndFile::sndfile` config target) with the Visual Studio generator, MSVC-safe warning flags (`/W4 /EHsc /utf-8 /permissive-`), and links ole32/uuid/avrt/psapi. `HeaderBar` CPU/RAM now use GetProcessTimes/GetProcessMemoryInfo instead of /proc. |
| Packaging | REAL (portable + installer, CI-verified) | Tag-driven `release` workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`, on `v*` tags) builds + tests + packages both platforms, then publishes one GitHub Release with both installers attached: `misuc_<ver>-<rel>_amd64.deb` (CPack DEB, shlibdeps, AppStream metainfo, dpkg triggers for icon/desktop caches) and `misuc-<ver>-<rel>-win64.exe` (CPack NSIS, Misuc-themed wizard art, exe icon+version resource; payload carries the complete Qt runtime via windeployqt, the whole vcpkg runtime DLL set (sndfile.dll + z.dll + codec chain) AND the MSVC CRT redist staged from the toolchain). v0.3.1 is the first installer that is CI smoke-tested end-to-end on both platforms: Linux = apt install + dpkg state + offscreen launch; Windows = silent NSIS install to a scratch dir, payload assertion for Qt/codecs/CRT, process-stays-alive launch check, silent uninstall removal check, then the published .exe has been independently re-inspected (7z) to confirm the runtime DLLs are inside. NOT CLAIMED: an interactive double-click wizard run on real Windows hardware, and WASAPI audio on real hardware.
| LV2 on Windows | DISABLED | lilv/lv2 discovery is skipped on Windows; sessions round-trip the fx schema and the UI marks the feature unsupported, same as a Linux build without lilv. |
| Linux parity | UNCHANGED | The Linux build path (PipeWire + pkg-config + CPack DEB) is byte-identical in intent; only the platform split is new. Linux tests still run the PipeWire live suite. |
